title: Retail Inventory Integration Pipeline
business: Retailers managing multi-source inventory data who need unified reporting without manual coding.
problem: High operational overhead and data silos caused by disparate inventory systems, leading to inconsistent stock levels across regional warehouses.
solution: Cloud Data Fusion provides a managed graphical data integration service built around pipelines and connectors to centralize and transform inventory data into a unified format.
steps: Provision a Cloud Data Fusion instance within the Google Cloud project.
Configure source connectors to ingest raw inventory data from regional warehouse databases.
Utilize the graphical interface to design transformation pipelines that normalize stock units and timestamps.
Deploy the pipeline to execute data movement and transformation into the central data warehouse.
Monitor pipeline execution status and logs through the integrated dashboard.
outcome: A streamlined, automated data flow that ensures consistent inventory visibility across all retail locations.
limitation: The visual pipeline approach may abstract complex logic; developers should check the execution logs to identify performance bottlenecks in high-volume data transformations.
